itemListElement.name: Digital Partner

Up to 300 new leads a month, one city included. Ad budget paid by the client. One-time setup fee of INR 25,000. Minimum three months.

mainEntity.name: Another agency quoted me ₹25,000 a month. Why is BrandSure higher?

acceptedAnswer.text: A ₹25,000 retainer usually buys campaign management only, shared across many industries. Agency Plan at ₹45,000 buys a team that works only on Indian furniture and sofa businesses. Digital Partner at ₹75,000 buys the part most furniture businesses are actually losing money on — somebody calling every enquiry, following up on WhatsApp and booking the showroom visit. Compare it to what a telecaller, a marketing executive, a designer and a CRM would cost you in-house.

mainEntity.name: What happens if it does not work in three months?

acceptedAnswer.text: Agency Plan and Digital Partner carry a three-month minimum and then continue month to month. Three months is the shortest honest window to run campaigns, gather data and fix what the data shows. You get a review on real numbers at the end of month one, so you are never waiting three months to find out.

mainEntity.name: Do you work with my competitor in the same city?

acceptedAnswer.text: Territory and selling locations are agreed in writing before work starts. Digital Partner includes one city, with additional cities at ₹20,000 per month each. Ask about your specific city and category before you sign.

mainEntity.name: What do you need from me?

acceptedAnswer.text: Access to your ad accounts and WhatsApp number, your product and price list, and a regular flow of fresh photos and videos from the showroom, factory, installations and completed work. Ads built on real work outperform ads built on stock images, and this is the one input BrandSure cannot produce for you.

mainEntity.name: Is there a way to work with BrandSure beyond marketing?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Selected furniture manufacturers can work with BrandSure under a longer-term Growth Partnership covering growth, product, sales systems and business development. It is a different business relationship rather than a larger marketing package, it is qualification-led, and the partnership structure is explained after a business review.
